methodology.bootstrap: One clean single-project run per mode; no inference for direct bootstrap.
methodology.followups: Twelve tool-result follow-ups per variant, four per client surface, sequential runs with batching enabled.
methodology.workload: Synthetic text and exact tool schemas; 0/1024-character arguments and 128-byte/32-KiB file slices.
methodology.timestamps: Observed relay/client stream events, not internal model-token timestamps.
methodology.uncertainty: Small samples and provider/cache variation; no statistical significance or throughput improvement claimed.
